description: At CaminoCode, I play an integral role as a full stack developer, participating in the design and development of interactive interfaces with React and Next.js, integrating external APIs through NestJS and Go, and optimizing performance and scalability in SaaS platforms with PostgreSQL. Additionally, I collaborated on the redesign of the company logo, contributing to the visual identity and brand consistency. My work combines technical implementation with user experience criteria, ensuring functional and consistent solutions for assigned projects.

I developed an application for the Qatar 2022 World Cup that was used by more than 400 employees, allowing them to make predictions and participate in friendly bets. The system was a success, remaining operational without interruptions throughout the entire championship.
In the frontend, I used React to design a dynamic and intuitive interface.
In the backend, I implemented business logic with .NET and managed real-time data with SQL Server, ensuring optimal performance and a seamless user experience.

I implemented key improvements in the system, optimizing workflows and developing new functionalities.
In the frontend, I used Angular and Bootstrap to create responsive components and interactive forms that facilitated order management and shipment tracking.
In the backend, I worked with .NET, applying SOLID principles and Clean Architecture, developing RESTful API services integrated with other internal systems. I optimized queries and stored procedures in SQL Server to improve data access.
I followed a repository pattern to organize the code and used Git, TeamCity, and Octopus for version control and deployment. Additionally, I conducted integration tests with Postman to ensure compatibility between internal systems.
